$comment: .jairus/jairus.json — the plugin's control footprint, in the product's `.jairus/` folder. Seeded by /jairus:init at Gate F1 (the starter pin is completed by the bootstrap card) and updated only by commands (never agents) per rules/transitions.md. It guides the jairus plugin only: the app builds and runs WITHOUT it. It is NOT the source of truth for feature/stage status — the backlog is (.jairus/product-backlog.json in DEV, the GitHub Project in QA; rules/state-model.md). It holds the version anchor, the mode, the starter pin, the remote, foundation progress, the backlog pointer, the plugin list, a resume cursor and a cached snapshot.

workflow.$comment: where the project is, written by every command through bin/state.mjs and read by /jairus:help. phase: start | build | release. next = the single next command and why. The backlog stays authoritative for card stages.

foundation.$comment: gates the feature pipeline. status: pending | green. scope: skeleton (DEV: build and backlog proof, environment deferred) | release (QA, deployed proof). steps.<F-step> = { step: done|deferred|failed|skipped, at, ref } — written by init

cursor.note: Resume hint only — reconcile against the backlog before acting.

snapshot.$comment: Last-known backlog state, cached for fast read. The backlog is authoritative. features.<f> = { stage, plugin, gate5 } where gate5 = done | deferred | n/a (written by develop, read by deploy).
